content.general_clinical_information: The guideline discusses various aspects of coronary revascularization, focusing on the safety and efficacy of different stent types, the role of intravascular imaging, and the outcomes of different intravascular imaging techniques. It includes multiple studies comparing drug-eluting stents versus bare-metal stents, the impact of intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) guidance, and the use of bioabsorbable polymers. It also reviews outcomes associated with techniques like optical coherence tomography (OCT) and fractional flow reserve (FFR) in guiding procedures and improving clinical outcomes.
